name: iron-front
description: Iron Front — a two-nation modern warfare strategy game for web, PWA and mobile.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run cap:sync && cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run cap:sync && cap run ios
scripts.test:stuck: npm run build:test && node test/stuckrun.js --map city --buy tank,apc,howitzer,mlrs --count 30 --checks 5,120,600
scripts.shot: npm run build:test && node test/shot.js shot.png
